scheme_name: Grant of Annual Scholarship to the Students Belonging to UT of Puducherry Selected and Studying in the Sainik School, Amaravathi Nagar, Tamil Nadu
other_conditions: Applicant must be a citizen of India
Applicant must be a recipient of the National Child Award for Exceptional Achievements and other national/international merit awards
Applicant must belong to the UT of Puducherry either by birth or by continuous residence of at least 5 years
Applicant must have studied from an educational institution located in the UT of Puducherry that is a government or private school recognised by the State/Central Government
Applicant must be studying in the Sainik School, Amaravathi Nagar, Tamil Nadu
benefits_summary: Scholarship of ₹10,000 per annum per student, disbursed directly into Aadhaar‑seeded bank account via Direct Benefit Transfer.
